The WhyWhyGalaI
Posted on December 9, 2019 by dejablog
The WhyWhyGala is an annual celebration of the end of the semester. This year’s gala was held on December 7th at the University of Washington’s Husky Union Building. It was a great success, with over 50 people in attendance. The event was catered by the UW Catering and Events team, and was absolutely delicious! Everyone enjoyed a variety of food, including vegetarian and gluten-free options.
